open_version_questions: Confirm from original ethics or institutional records that the official ClinicalTrials.gov association correctly binds both NCT-free PDFs to NCT03854253/TCRC-146; the exact title, institution and registry document date agree.
Confirm that the ambiguous cover date 02/11/2019 means 11 February 2019, as represented by the official registry metadata, rather than 2 November 2019.
review_requirements: Resolve the protocol's simple-blind statement against the registry's open-label metadata and identify the masked role.
Define the primary RAO diagnostic rule, assessment time, estimand, analysis population and missing-ultrasound sensitivity analysis.
Confirm whether Fisher exact testing is the primary method and add arm risks, effect estimates and confidence intervals.
Specify how technical access failure, wrong device, conversion and CAG-versus-PCI or operator effects enter the analysis.
Supply a prospective sample-size target and calculation; do not use title number 146 or actual enrollment as a substitute.
Define multiplicity, secondary endpoint derivations, safety population and adverse-event summaries.
notes: First-pass evidence-backed annotation. The reference plan is independent and pre-recruitment but extremely terse; most executable decisions remain expert-review gates.
